evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: OBS-NTERCHNG-HOMEPAGE-CREDIT-AND-VENUE names Drew Bolton, Jamie Burkart, and Garrett Fuselier together; OBS-NTERCHNG-PITCH-INSTALLATION-FORM independently corroborates the software, spatial, and real-time interaction form.

CLM-NTERCHNG-COLLABORATIVE-INSTALLATION explicitly credits all three collaborators, while its boundaries and anti-claims prohibit assigning coding, wall design, motion graphics, installation, or production work to Jamie individually.

CLM-NTERCHNG-AMERICA-NOW-HERE-EXHIBITION traces inclusion through the official artist index and shared artist-detail observations. SRC-NTERCHNG-NERMAN-ANH-2011-04-30 is only a supports-boundary relationship, with explicit anti-claims against Nerman placement and direct Barbara Kruger collaboration.

SRC-NTERCHNG-ANH-ARTIST-DETAIL-2011-05-18 is public-metadata-only, contains no canonicalUrl, archiveUrl, or assetUrl, and both claim relationships set renderCitation=false. Repository scans found no phone number or email payload in the NTER CHNG candidate files.

RT-NTERCHNG-ARTIFACTS-AND-DIVISION-OF-WORK and INQ-NTERCHNG-WAYBACK-ANH-2026-07-15 explicitly retain press-release non-recovery, video playability and rights, audience measures, reusable media, and individual work allocation as unresolved.
Read-only parsing found the complete 1-capture, 7-source, 8-observation, 2-claim, 1-task, 1-inquiry graph with zero validation errors.
findings: Residual limitation: individual responsibilities and reusable-media rights remain unknown, but the candidate correctly avoids inference and routes both to an open collaborator-aware task.
External source contents were not independently re-retrieved under the required no-network constraint; the judgment therefore rests on the repository's atomic observations and bounded source records.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve the current equal-credit and anti-claim boundaries; pursue RT-NTERCHNG-ARTIFACTS-AND-DIVISION-OF-WORK before making any collaborator-specific implementation claim.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: CLM-NTERCHNG-COLLABORATIVE-INSTALLATION names Jamie's defensible direct action as co-creation and explains what became usable: a two-sided installation turning one-to-one text exchanges into a shared many-to-many gallery dialog.

docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nterchng.md presents the work as early participatory-system lineage, states the collective purpose and result clearly, and candidly separates recovered facts from press, media-rights, role-allocation, and audience unknowns.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md places both claims under Strong Future Feature Candidates and conditions future use on visual-rights and division-of-work review, preserving their hiring value without premature promotion.

Both NTER CHNG claims are public-safe but dormant, project only to docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nterchng, appear in no citation page, and are absent from public-registry.json. An in-memory reconstruction confirmed the existing public registry remains current and byte-equivalent.

The diff changes no app route, hiring-facing page, work content, proofs data, or public registry. Route inventory contains no proofs, knowledge-bank, public-claims, or NTER CHNG route; git diff --check reported no defect.
The reported fingerprint was independently recomputed from all 46 lifecycle candidate files and matched exactly.
findings: No material KD-012 defect or public-copy regression observed.

Residual limitation: NTER CHNG is not yet suitable for a hiring-facing case study because individual implementation ownership, playable rights-cleared media, and audience evidence remain unresolved; keeping it dormant is the promotion-safe choice.
No project-ending evidence is present, and the candidate appropriately does not invent an ending or treat archival dormancy as failure.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep both claims dormant while completing the rights and collaborator-confirmation task; consider a future projection only if that evidence strengthens the hiring argument without displacing more relevant current work.
